# Rafiq v0.4.27 — your identity, the model's craft

Designs and motion videos now come out at a studio level even from small, cheap models — and every design is yours, not a template.

---

## 🎨 Designs start from your visual identity

- **Build the identity first, like a design system.**
  - A new design opens on an identity builder: colours by role (with contrast warnings), three fonts from 38 Google Fonts, corners, shadows, spacing, motion, and light, dark or both.
  - Eight styles to start from (minimal, bold, luxury, playful, dark tech, editorial, crafted, corporate) fill everything in one click; then change anything.
  - A live preview shows the result as you go.
- **Identities are saved** and start any number of designs.
- **The model designs with your identity, exactly.** It gets your colours and fonts as tokens it must use, and decides only the layout, the sections and the signature moves. Two designs never come out as the same page.
- **A studio guide for every model.** Type sizes, composition, drawing the product in the page, motion levels, Arabic and RTL rules, and the mistakes that make a page look machine-made.
- **Review and improve (`/راجع`).** Checks that the page:
  - sticks to the identity;
  - has a leading headline, enough sections, motion and hover;
  - survives a phone and RTL;
  - has no AI tells.

  The model then fixes the page section by section.

## 🎬 Motion videos that look professional

- **A director's guide and a finished example reel** reach the model from the first message.
- **Full freedom:** any palette, any Google Font, and any shape drawn as a path.
- **Review and improve, shot by shot.** The engine measures every shot and returns concrete notes, which even models that can't see images can act on. It checks:
  - hero size;
  - how much of the frame is filled and where the content sits;
  - whether anything moves while a shot holds;
  - transition length.
- **A `sweep` transition**: a colour panel that crosses the frame on a cut, in one line.
- **Bigger type for reels**: each video can set its own type scale, and any text an exact size.
- **Deep Arabic letters** (like ي in a large display font) no longer touch the line below.

## ⌨️ A `/` menu for each page

- **The motion page:** review, check, shot, colours, fonts, sound, length, aspect, preview, export.
- **The design page:** review, motion, colours, fonts, section, page, mobile, dark, build.

Chat-only commands stay in chats.

---

**Updating:** installed copies offer this update on their own. New installs: download `Rafiq_0.4.27_x64-setup.exe` below and check it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`:

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\Rafiq_0.4.27_x64-setup.exe -Algorithm SHA256
```
